chapter: Armstrong band memories, Chicago players and Baltimore
title: Visiting the dying Freddie Keppard with Armstrong
summary: On the first trip out of Chicago, Armstrong has the bus driver take the band to see Keppard, who died a week later.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: So, speaking of Louis Armstrong, I'd like to go back and get to a little story.

On the -- on the -- one of our trips, you know, like, our first trip out of town, we had the bus, and we were on our way to St. Louis. And, Louis says, "Well, now, wait a minute." He says, "I want the bus driver, I want you to drive around, I'll tell you where to go, because we got to go see Freddy Keppert, because Freddy --

-- Freddy Keppert, they don't think he's going to live too long. And, here was a name I knew, but I'd never met the man. And, Louis took us all up there to see Freddy Keppert, and he was like on his death bed.
He was down on Vincennes Avenue.
That is correct. And, we -- he didn't last but, maybe, a week after we left there, he was dead.
You know, I had been playing with him?
(Inaudible.) I had been playing with him then.
Oh, man. Yeah, he was some guy.
Louis used to talk about him all the time.
